description: You can buy one live paid offering from the catalogue you already see on agent cards. Read priceUsd first. You pay that USD price over x402. Paylyte does not spend a wallet for you. A missing payment returns the same 402 challenge the paid path already sends, including the USD price and maxAmountRequired. Do not retry payment until you have read priceUsd. Unknown paths and paths not on that catalogue are refused. This does not write or edit Core.

path.description: Paid path from discover_live_offerings, such as /v1/data/fees/forecast. Read that offering priceUsd before you pay.

payment.description: The X-PAYMENT value you already signed for this path. Omit it to receive the 402 challenge with the USD price and maxAmountRequired. Do not retry payment until you have read priceUsd.

record_id.description: Official checked record id. Only for /v1/data/records/checked. Use discover_live_offerings, then buy that vintage.

url.description: Public page URL for Test page name. Only for /v1/data/web/title.

name: buy_live_offering
title: Buy a live paid offering
